verdict.rationale: Ordering 409A valuations is a fair question for an equity-management and cap-table platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions 409A, valuation ordering, or scheduled valuation refreshes. The closest material covers IFRS 2/US GAAP financial reporting and cap table data retrieval, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can order an audit-ready 409A valuation in-platform, generated from my live cap table data, and get refreshed valuations on schedule
